import itertools

n = 4
nums = list(range(n))
diffs_target = set(range(1, n))

solutions = []
for perm in itertools.permutations(nums):
    diffs = [abs(perm[i] - perm[i+1]) for i in range(n-1)]
    if set(diffs) == diffs_target:
        solutions.append(perm)

print("Solutions:", solutions)
print("Count:", len(solutions))
